- Murni Holdings Sdn. Bhd. holds 100.0% of shares  

**Overview:**  
Sejahtera Kirana Resort Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited hospitality firm operating as a travel agency for umrah and inbound tourism, based in Perlis. The company was incorporated on 13 April 2012 and has a share capital of RM 100,000. It is wholly owned (100 %) by Murni Holdings Sdn. Bhd. and is directed by two individuals. Revenue has declined from RM 9,473,836 in 2022 to RM 8,185,760 in 2024, with consecutive net losses and negative cash flow reported.
